review_candidates.title: Modern Device Management Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description Essential Job Functions: Administer and support Microsoft Intune for enterprise-managed endpoints. Troubleshoot device enrolment failures, policy conflicts, application deployment failures and other endpoint-management issues. Maintain operational documentation, knowledge articles, and support procedures Work with Service Desk, security, endpoint, infrastructure, and other resolver teams Participate in knowledge transfer and operational-readiness activities where required. Basic
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree, diploma or equivalent qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and Windows endpoint management. Other Qualifications: Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate / MD-102 or equivalent Microsoft endpoint-management certification. Experience Requirements 5+ years experience appropriate to a Senior Analyst I position, with practical experience in enterprise Modern Workplace, endpoint management or end-user computing environments. Candidates should demonstrate hands-on operational capability in Microsoft Intune and Windows endpoint management, combined with experience or knowledge of digital employee experience monitoring, automation and proactive endpoint support.
